model.declaration: closed permissions.model logical entities and fields; no arbitrary scripts or SQL
model.configuration: native Host selection and exact plan confirmation; canonical table/field identities

catalog.pageBudget: both 32 items and the complete PocketBase HTTP JSON response bytes, including model and continuation; an unrepresentable single item is rejected
catalog.fields: selected tableId plus required schemaRevision, optional offset; fieldId/displayName/logicalType summaries and nextOffset
catalog.validation: current workspace and installation on every page; selected schema revision on every field page

model.authorization: explicit logical-role grants only after complete configuration; current installation rechecked
model.recovery: durable per-step progress; read/status after cancellation or unknown reply; never imply rollback or automatically replay
model.upgrade: additive schema operations only; renames preserve identity, incompatible changes fail closed

transactions.declaration: closed permissions.transactions rules over confirmed model logical entities and fields; unique/reference/conservation/balance/state only; no arbitrary SQL, scripts or unconstrained values
transactions.configuration: transaction.configure registers the manifest declaration after native confirmation; persisted rules survive plugin disable; declaration modelId must equal permissions.model modelId
transactions.numbers: model-bound Text stores canonical fixed-scale decimal text; verified Number fields may use safe integer minor units; shared bounded integer coefficients parse, compare and sum; no float aggregation or implicit rounding
transactions.plan: transaction.preview persists the normalized plan with a stable requestId; the prepared reply carries effects [{tableId, recordId, operation, schemaRevision, expectedDigest? for rows with a before state}], per-table dataRevisions baselines and a monotonic previewRevision >= 1; temporary references bind pre-allocated row ids across tables and one atomic commit
transactions.previewBoundary: preview computes effects and baselines by reusing the Kernel write session on an in-memory record overlay: no PocketBase writes, file hooks, business receipts or publishers; it confirms only the affected boundary and never claims business rules such as balance or conservation pass early
transactions.refresh: explicit {requestId, plan, refresh: true} on transaction.preview reuses the same requestId with an identical plan, keeps newIds, recomputes effects and baselines and increments previewRevision by exactly one; a different plan is input_conflict; requestIds are never rekeyed or auto-refreshed
transactions.submit: public transaction.submit stays {requestId}; the Host takes the current prepared version through native confirmation and forwards its previewRevision to Host-only transaction.commit, which requires previewRevision >= 1 and equal to the persisted prepared revision
transactions.commit: Host-only commit re-verifies, inside the same business transaction, that the actual derived write-set effects and per-table base revisions equal the persisted prepared values; any drift is transaction.plan_stale with zero writes and requires an explicit refresh followed by renewed native confirmation; the persisted applied result keeps newIds and the receipt without effects or baselines
transactions.recovery: transaction.submit consumes one requestId exactly once; missing, stale or epoch-expired ids and unprovable outcomes return unknown; verified success is sticky; never auto-replay, rekey or resubmit

files.ownership: surface, installation id/revision/package, workspace epoch, Host run and purpose

dataIo.tasks: existing HostDataIoTaskRegistry only; scoped handles; status polling
dataIo.import: Python preview, Go plan owner; upsert frozen before native confirmation; canonical single-table mutation <=1000
dataIo.export: explicit fields and authorized query; CSV/XLSX ExportService; raw relation ids only
dataIo.outputReceipt: verified success is sticky; lost receipt is unknown and never replayed
dataIo.files: Host-chosen import/export purpose; same broker; 32 MiB new plugin policy distinct from ordinary 1 MiB
dataIo.importPreview: up to 20 sample rows / 128 KiB; summary covers the complete <=1000-row plan; invalid preview has null planId

attachments.handles: surface-owned opaque references; no raw staged handles, stored names or download tickets
attachments.write: Host-native file selection, staged principal/record/field/file binding, canonical setAttachments and native confirmation
attachments.read: current Go installation and field grant checked for each bounded block
attachments.stageTransport: Host-only attachment.stage JSON envelope <=2 MiB including base64; decoded file <=1 MiB; all other surface HTTP requests <=1 MiB

outputs.source: immutable plugin-declared templateVersion, dataVersion and purpose; not independently verified business facts
outputs.ownership: current surface, installation and workspace; ordinary file and attachment budgets unchanged
outputs.save: native target selection and atomic replacement; stable saveId recovers an in-session receipt; unknown never auto-replays
outputs.archive: existing canonical attachment mutation and native confirmation; immutable artifact source audit in the same business transaction
outputs.reopen: opaque archived artifactId, current installation and canonical field authorization, original issued bytes
outputs.print: opened preview only, never a successful physical printing receipt

ui.transport: trusted parent; existing vibetable.plugin-surface.v1 action service=ui; never a Product RPC
ui.context: presentation only; Go-authorized context.read remains the data authority
ui.tasks: only native tasks owned by the current surface; cancelRequested is not settlement; no confirmation fields
